name: engine_window_embedded
description: EW-2: the engine Studio starts never shows a window outside Studio. Studio starts it --embedded (EW-1), so the engine creates its window hidden and unfocused; Studio finds it by the engine's mark rather than by its being visible, waits out the load as before, and shows it only once it is Studio's child. The driver watches every top-level window of Studio's child processes from the launch on, many times a second, and each check below requires that none was ever visible and that the watch saw each engine's load (its marked window hidden and still top-level) in at least three samples, and that the newest engine's window is now on screen as a child of Studio's window. Checked for the engine Studio starts with the project, for Restart Engine after a stop, and for a switch to another project.

the engine has stopped, and the button offers Restart Engine
